channel.title: Device Performance Monitor
channel.description: Updates for Device Performance Monitor — live memory, CPU, thread and frame-rate monitoring from Coursion.

item.title: Version 1.4.0
item.description: Threshold alerts, a screenshot & record tool, a headless CLI recorder (dpm record) for CI, chart image export, and much sharper build comparisons (expandable categories, build-mismatch warning, shipped-vs-metadata charts). Plus export-truncation notes, an iOS running-state fix, friendlier empty states and accessibility improvements.
